email.welcome.subject: Welcome to QFlowLearn beta
email.welcome.ready: Welcome to QFlowLearn beta. Your account is ready, so you can start building, arranging, previewing, and exporting assessments.
email.welcome.platform: QFlowLearn is powered by QFlow, the open-source assessment authoring project, and built around Question and Test Interoperability (QTI) 3.0. QTI 3.0 helps content move between systems while supporting accessible assessment experiences.
email.welcome.beta: QFlowLearn is still in beta, and we improve it every day. You may encounter rough edges or see features change.
email.welcome.feedback: We want to hear from you. Tell us what works, what gets in your way, and how we can improve. Tips, ideas, and bug reports are all welcome.
email.welcome.signoff:
Thanks for trying QFlowLearn,
The QFlowLearn team
email.reset.subject: Reset your QFlowLearn password
email.reset.requested: A password reset was requested for your QFlowLearn account.
email.reset.linkInstruction: Use this link to set a new password:
email.reset.expiry: This link expires in one hour and can only be used once.
email.reset.ignore: If you did not request this reset, you can ignore this email.
